title: Agora Podcasts
tagline: Turn any topic into a live two-host podcast listeners can talk to.
description: Create a two-host podcast from a topic, notes, or an article. Agora RTC broadcasts the show to listeners, who can ask a spoken question and hear a contextual answer before playback resumes.
author: zicojiao
